title: Event report
intro: What happened at the event, in numbers: how full the hall was, peak bandwidth, switch outages, the ports with the most problems and every incident. Download it as a PDF after the event.
peopleHelp: Admins only. Personal data: the download goes to the audit log.
peopleOn: This report includes nicks and IPs. Handle it as personal data.
newEventQuestion: Start a new event? The report's history (hours, outages, problem ports) and the peak begin again. Incidents and check-ins stay on their own pages.
empty: No port reads kept yet: the report fills in while the event runs.
chartSeatsLabel: Most seats online and checked in, per hour
chartBandwidthLabel: Busiest read and average bandwidth, per hour
kept: Port reads are folded into one row per hour and kept for 21 days, switch outages and problem ports since the last new event.
